upstream_defect.description: reports gitignored files as untracked by construction

diagnosis: The gate's own suite pollutes the artifact dirs it then judges: a bead can be refused for a file the gate itself wrote. Proof on this bead: the 13:03-13:52Z gate finished and left 21 .pyc in 18 experiment dirs, including experiments/gpu-sim-u2o.17.3/sim_trace_173.cpython-314.pyc at 13:38:17Z (inside the gate's pytest window). experiment_untracked_paths (lab.py:20737) calls gitignored files untracked because it asks 'git ls-files --error-unmatch' per file.
mitigation: In-repo suppression in ROOT tests/conftest.py (effective before landing, applies regardless of how pytest is invoked): sys.pycache_prefix = <repo>/.lab/tmp/pycache plus os.environ.setdefault('PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX', <same>) so spawned subprocesses inherit it. lab.config.json tests.command also sets PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.lab/tmp/pycache as belt-and-braces, but this does NOT fix the gate (lab resolves tests.command from the MAIN tree, so a branch-local entry never reaches the validating gate).
fix_reaches_gate: yes, via root conftest.py imported by every pytest invocation including scripts/gate.sh:125

probe.description: AC1: throwaway dir experiments/gpu-sim-1upd-probe/ created with __pycache__/x.pyc and fk/probe.out (both gitignored). The wrong guard query (git ls-files --error-unmatch per file, i.e. unfiltered git ls-files --others -- experiments/<probe>) flags both files; the correct query (git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- experiments/<probe>) returns empty because they are gitignored. Confirms the guard refuses the dir pre-fix and that the fix is to stop emitting the files.

cleanup.description: One-time cleanup of pre-existing pycache from pre-fix gate runs (gitignored junk), declared with before/after counts.

negative_control: Without the redirect (plain python, no PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX, no conftest): importing a module under experiments/<id>/ creates __pycache__/*.pyc there and the unfiltered guard (git ls-files --others -- experiments/) flags it. With the redirect: no .pyc under experiments/ and bytecode lands under .lab/tmp/pycache. Pair demonstrated in run.sh.
two_suite_evidence: tests/test_8zqr.py (6 passed) and tests/test_bk9_gate.py (2 passed) run unchanged under both the old and new command; full suite covers experiments/gpu-sim-u2o.17.3 (test_sim_trace_173.py) and other beads importing modules under experiments/.
